$comment: Condition table for JARVIS, the fleet supervisor. Evaluated every tick against zero-token signals (PTY tail, status, quiet time, git state). Override per-machine with ~/.agent-workspace/supervisor-rules.json.
$comment_autonomy: off = nothing runs. observe = record only. assist = may resolve things itself. autopilot = may also delegate to the Commander. Interrupting a human is gated separately by interruption policy, NOT by autonomy — the point is to act, not to narrate.
$comment_interruption: The human is the most expensive resource in the system and every interruption costs a context switch. A finding only reaches you if it scores above the threshold AND fits the budget; everything else self-heals silently or waits for the digest.

interruption.$comment_tiers: Tier weights come from the task record. T1 is what you are actually working on; T3/T4 is background work that should never pull you out of flow — fix it or park it.

safety.$comment: Resolve/delegate handlers are named functions in server/supervisor/supervisorActions.js. Rules select a handler; they cannot inject shell.
safety.$comment_permission: An auto-answered permission prompt must match one of these AND none of the deny patterns. Anything else is escalated, never guessed.
safety.$comment_deny_paths: A permission prompt to Edit/Write is auto-approvable in general, but NOT for targets that execute on the next ordinary operation — a poisoned build script, git hook, CI workflow or shell rc turns an approved edit plus an already-allowlisted `npm run build`/`git commit` into arbitrary code execution. Any write to these fails closed to a human.

$comment_conditions: Ordered by urgency — the first match per session wins. `resolve` is what JARVIS does about it without asking. `escalateAfterAttempts` is how many failed self-heals before it is allowed to reach you at all.

conditions.label: Waiting on an approval (reported, not guessed)
conditions.$comment: The Codex app-server reports waitingOnApproval as a fact, so this fires in seconds rather than waiting out a quiet-time threshold to be confident a prompt is really stuck.
conditions.advice: An agent reported it is blocked on an approval that could not be auto-granted safely.

conditions.label: Thread reported a system error
conditions.advice: The agent runtime itself reported a system error — this is not something a nudge fixes.

conditions.label: Waiting on a permission prompt

tailMatches: Do you want to (proceed|make this edit|create)

conditions.advice: An agent is blocked on a permission prompt that could not be auto-approved safely.

conditions.label: Usage limit reached
conditions.advice: Blocked until the window resets. Resume is scheduled automatically — there is nothing for you to do, so this never interrupts.

conditions.label: Repeating the same error
conditions.advice: The same error keeps recurring — the agent is looping and cannot see it.

conditions.label: Busy but silent

resolve.text: status? If you are blocked, say what on, then resolve it yourself if you can.

tailNotMatches: Do you want to (proceed|make this edit)

conditions.advice: Marked busy with no output for 15 minutes and did not respond to nudges.

conditions.label: Agent exited, shell left behind
conditions.advice: The agent CLI is gone and could not be relaunched.

conditions.label: Finished with unpushed commits

resolve.text: You have local commits that are not pushed. Push the branch and open a PR, then say what you shipped.

conditions.advice: Finished work has not left the machine and nudges did not shift it.

conditions.label: Idle with uncommitted changes

resolve.text: You have uncommitted changes. Commit them with a descriptive message, or say why they should not be committed.

conditions.advice: Edits sitting in the working tree with nothing recorded.

conditions.label: Idle worktree, nothing in flight
conditions.advice: Free capacity — this worktree could take the next queue item.
